lead_with.title: Better detection antibodies, faster
lead_with.text: Diagnostic assays live or die on **affinity, specificity and lot-to-lot consistency**. Pitch in-silico affinity maturation and specificity optimization of existing hybridoma clones, ending with a recombinant, sequence-defined antibody.

lead_with.title: Rescue hard targets
lead_with.text: For difficult antigens (cross-reactive variants, infectious-disease strains), MAbSilico can design or refine binders in ~21 days instead of new immunization campaigns.

lead_with.title: A service for BBI's own clients
lead_with.text: BBI sells custom antibody development. An in-silico optimization step could become an add-on to BBI's offer — partner model.

company.text: BBI Solutions, part of BBI Group (UK, manufacturing in several countries), supplies the **in-vitro diagnostics** and life-science market with enzymes, antigens, antibodies, gold colloid and conjugates, human serum and controls, plus services: antibody development and production, lateral-flow contract manufacturing and custom gold conjugation. In 2026 it exhibited at ADA 2026 (New Orleans) with antibodies and antigens for diabetes assays.
